<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,
initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Saanjh — Odisha Fashion</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com"
crossorigin>
<link
href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,w
ght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@300;40
0;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet"
href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/css/al
l.min.css">
<style>
:root {
--bg-ivory: #FAF9F6;
--pure-white: #FFFFFF;
--text-dark: #121824;
--text-muted: #5A6474;
--accent-burgundy: #6B1D2F;
--accent-burgundy-hover: #521523;
--gold: #C5A059;
--border-light: #E4E7EC;
--shadow-subtle: 0 10px 30px rgba(18, 24, 36, 0.05);
--shadow-hover: 0 15px 35px rgba(18, 24, 36, 0.1);
--transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}
* {
margin: 0;
padding: 0;
box-sizing: border-box;
}
html {
scroll-behavior: smooth;
}
body {
font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
background-color: var(--bg-ivory);
color: var(--text-dark);
line-height: 1.6;
overflow-x: hidden;
}
h1, h2, h3, h4, .serif-font {
font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
font-weight: 600;
}
a {
text-decoration: none;
color: inherit;
}
ul {
list-style: none;
}
button {
cursor: pointer;
border: none;
background: none;
font-family: inherit;
}
/* Top Promo Bar */
.promo-bar {
background-color: var(--text-dark);
color: var(--pure-white);
text-align: center;
padding: 10px 16px;
font-size: 0.85rem;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
font-weight: 500;
}
/* Header */
header {
position: sticky;
top: 0;
background-color: rgba(250, 249, 246, 0.95);
backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
z-index: 1000;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.header-container {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 20px 40px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: space-between;
}
.brand-logo {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
cursor: pointer;
}
.brand-logo h1 {
font-size: 1.8rem;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
color: var(--text-dark);
line-height: 1.1;
}
.brand-logo span {
font-size: 0.7rem;
letter-spacing: 0.3em;
color: var(--accent-burgundy);
font-weight: 600;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.nav-links {
display: flex;
gap: 36px;
}
.nav-links a {
font-size: 0.95rem;
font-weight: 500;
color: var(--text-dark);
transition: var(--transition);
position: relative;
}
.nav-links a::after {
content: '';
position: absolute;
bottom: -4px;
left: 0;
width: 0;
height: 1px;
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
transition: var(--transition);
}
.nav-links a:hover::after,
.nav-links a.active::after {
width: 100%;
}
.header-actions {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 24px;
}
.action-icon-btn {
position: relative;
font-size: 1.2rem;
color: var(--text-dark);
transition: var(--transition);
padding: 8px;
}
.action-icon-btn:hover {
color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.badge-count {
position: absolute;
top: 2px;
right: 2px;
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
font-size: 0.65rem;
font-weight: 700;
width: 18px;
height: 18px;
border-radius: 50%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
}
.mobile-menu-toggle {
display: none;
font-size: 1.4rem;
cursor: pointer;
}
/* Hero Section */
.hero-section {
position: relative;
height: 85vh;
min-height: 600px;
background: linear-gradient(rgba(18,24,36,0.3),
rgba(18,24,36,0.5)),
url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1610030469983-98e550d6193c?auto
=format&fit=crop&w=2000&q=80') center/cover no-repeat;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
text-align: center;
color: var(--pure-white);
padding: 0 20px;
}
.hero-content {
max-width: 800px;
animation: fadeIn 1s ease-out;
}
.hero-content h2 {
font-size: 3.5rem;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.hero-content .hero-sub {
font-size: 1rem;
letter-spacing: 0.4em;
text-transform: uppercase;
color: var(--gold);
margin-bottom: 24px;
font-weight: 600;
}
.hero-content p {
font-size: 1.4rem;
font-style: italic;
font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
margin-bottom: 36px;
opacity: 0.95;
}
.btn-primary {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
padding: 16px 36px;
font-size: 0.95rem;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
text-transform: uppercase;
font-weight: 600;
border-radius: 4px;
transition: var(--transition);
display: inline-block;
}
.btn-primary:hover {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy-hover);
transform: translateY(-2px);
box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(107, 29, 47, 0.3);
}
/* Category Section */
.category-section {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 100px 40px;
text-align: center;
}
.section-title {
font-size: 2.5rem;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
margin-bottom: 12px;
color: var(--text-dark);
}
.section-subtitle {
font-size: 1.05rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
margin-bottom: 60px;
}
.category-grid {
display: flex;
gap: 30px;
overflow-x: auto;
padding-bottom: 20px;
justify-content: flex-start;
scrollbar-width: none;
}
.category-grid::-webkit-scrollbar {
display: none;
}
.category-tile {
flex: 0 0 130px;
text-align: center;
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-tile:hover {
transform: translateY(-8px);
}
.category-circle {
width: 130px;
height: 130px;
border-radius: 50%;
overflow: hidden;
margin: 0 auto 16px;
border: 2px solid var(--border-light);
box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-tile:hover .category-circle {
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
}
.category-circle img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.category-tile:hover img {
transform: scale(1.08);
}
.category-tile h4 {
font-size: 0.9rem;
font-weight: 600;
color: var(--text-dark);
}
/* Festive Banner */
.festive-banner-section {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto 80px;
padding: 0 40px;
}
.festive-banner {
background: linear-gradient(135deg, #121824 0%, #2A364F
100%);
border-radius: 12px;
padding: 80px 60px;
color: var(--pure-white);
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: space-between;
position: relative;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(18,24,36,0.2);
}
.festive-content h2 {
font-size: 3rem;
letter-spacing: 0.08em;
margin-bottom: 16px;
color: var(--gold);
}
.festive-content p {
font-size: 1.15rem;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85);
margin-bottom: 36px;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.btn-festive {
background-color: var(--gold);
color: var(--text-dark);
padding: 16px 36px;
font-size: 0.95rem;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
text-transform: uppercase;
font-weight: 700;
border-radius: 4px;
transition: var(--transition);
display: inline-flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 12px;
}
.btn-festive:hover {
background-color: #d6af63;
transform: translateX(5px);
}
.festive-image {
width: 400px;
height: 300px;
border-radius: 8px;
overflow: hidden;
box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
}
.festive-image img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
}
/* Shop / Collection Area */
.shop-container {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 40px;
}
.shop-header-area {
text-align: center;
margin-bottom: 40px;
}
.shop-header-area h2 {
font-size: 2.2rem;
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.shop-header-area p {
color: var(--text-muted);
font-size: 0.95rem;
}
.shop-controls {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 24px;
margin-bottom: 40px;
}
.search-bar-wrap {
position: relative;
max-width: 600px;
margin: 0 auto;
width: 100%;
}
.search-bar-wrap i {
position: absolute;
left: 20px;
top: 50%;
transform: translateY(-50%);
color: var(--text-muted);
font-size: 1.1rem;
}
.search-input {
width: 100%;
padding: 16px 20px 16px 54px;
background-color: var(--pure-white);
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 30px;
font-size: 1rem;
color: var(--text-dark);
box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
transition: var(--transition);
}
.search-input:focus {
outline: none;
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
}
.filter-chips-wrap {
display: flex;
gap: 12px;
overflow-x: auto;
padding-bottom: 10px;
justify-content: center;
scrollbar-width: none;
}
.filter-chips-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar {
display: none;
}
.filter-chip {
padding: 10px 24px;
background-color: var(--pure-white);
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 30px;
font-size: 0.9rem;
font-weight: 500;
color: var(--text-dark);
cursor: pointer;
white-space: nowrap;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.filter-chip:hover,
.filter-chip.active {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.sort-row {
display: flex;
justify-content: flex-end;
align-items: center;
gap: 12px;
}
.sort-row label {
font-size: 0.9rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
font-weight: 500;
}
.sort-select {
padding: 10px 16px;
background-color: var(--pure-white);
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 6px;
font-size: 0.9rem;
color: var(--text-dark);
cursor: pointer;
outline: none;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.sort-select:focus {
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
/* Product Grid */
.product-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
gap: 30px;
margin-bottom: 80px;
}
.product-card {
background-color: var(--pure-white);
border-radius: 12px;
overflow: hidden;
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
transition: var(--transition);
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
position: relative;
}
.product-card:hover {
transform: translateY(-6px);
box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
}
.product-img-wrap {
position: relative;
height: 380px;
overflow: hidden;
background-color: #f1f3f5;
cursor: pointer;
}
.product-img-wrap img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.product-card:hover .product-img-wrap img {
transform: scale(1.05);
}
.product-badge {
position: absolute;
top: 14px;
left: 14px;
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
font-size: 0.7rem;
font-weight: 700;
padding: 5px 10px;
border-radius: 3px;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
text-transform: uppercase;
}
.wishlist-btn {
position: absolute;
top: 14px;
right: 14px;
width: 36px;
height: 36px;
background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
border-radius: 50%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
font-size: 1rem;
color: var(--text-dark);
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}
.wishlist-btn:hover,
.wishlist-btn.active {
color: #d90429;
background-color: var(--pure-white);
}
.product-info {
padding: 20px;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
flex-grow: 1;
}
.product-cat-name {
font-size: 0.75rem;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
color: var(--text-muted);
margin-bottom: 6px;
}
.product-title {
font-size: 1.05rem;
font-weight: 600;
color: var(--text-dark);
margin-bottom: 12px;
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
display: -webkit-box;
-webkit-line-clamp: 2;
-webkit-box-orient: vertical;
overflow: hidden;
}
.product-title:hover {
color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.product-pricing {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 10px;
margin-bottom: 16px;
margin-top: auto;
}
.current-price {
font-size: 1.15rem;
font-weight: 700;
color: var(--text-dark);
}
.original-price {
font-size: 0.95rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
text-decoration: line-through;
}
.discount-tag {
font-size: 0.8rem;
font-weight: 700;
color: #2b9348;
}
.btn-add-bag {
width: 100%;
padding: 12px;
background-color: var(--text-dark);
color: var(--pure-white);
font-size: 0.85rem;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
text-transform: uppercase;
font-weight: 600;
border-radius: 6px;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.btn-add-bag:hover {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.no-products {
grid-column: 1 / -1;
text-align: center;
padding: 80px 20px;
color: var(--text-muted);
font-size: 1.2rem;
font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
}
/* Product Detail Modal */
.modal-overlay {
position: fixed;
top: 0;
left: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
background-color: rgba(18,24,36,0.7);
backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
z-index: 2000;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
opacity: 0;
pointer-events: none;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.modal-overlay.open {
opacity: 1;
pointer-events: auto;
}
.modal-content {
background-color: var(--pure-white);
width: 100%;
max-width: 1000px;
border-radius: 16px;
overflow: hidden;
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
position: relative;
transform: translateY(20px);
transition: var(--transition);
}
.modal-overlay.open .modal-content {
transform: translateY(0);
}
.modal-close-btn {
position: absolute;
top: 20px;
right: 20px;
font-size: 1.5rem;
color: var(--text-dark);
z-index: 10;
cursor: pointer;
width: 40px;
height: 40px;
background-color: var(--bg-ivory);
border-radius: 50%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.modal-close-btn:hover {
background-color: var(--border-light);
}
.modal-img-area {
background-color: #f8f9fa;
height: 600px;
}
.modal-img-area img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
}
.modal-details-area {
padding: 50px 40px;
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
overflow-y: auto;
max-height: 600px;
}
.modal-title {
font-size: 1.8rem;
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.modal-desc {
font-size: 0.95rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
margin: 20px 0;
line-height: 1.7;
}
.modal-options-group {
margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.modal-options-group label {
display: block;
font-size: 0.85rem;
font-weight: 600;
margin-bottom: 8px;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.color-chips, .size-chips {
display: flex;
gap: 10px;
}
.color-chip {
width: 28px;
height: 28px;
border-radius: 50%;
border: 2px solid var(--border-light);
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.color-chip.selected {
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
transform: scale(1.1);
}
.size-chip {
padding: 8px 16px;
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 4px;
font-size: 0.85rem;
font-weight: 600;
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.size-chip.selected, .size-chip:hover {
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
}
.qty-action-row {
display: flex;
gap: 16px;
margin-top: auto;
padding-top: 20px;
}
.qty-selector {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 6px;
overflow: hidden;
}
.qty-btn {
width: 40px;
height: 48px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
font-size: 1rem;
background-color: var(--bg-ivory);
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.qty-btn:hover {
background-color: var(--border-light);
}
.qty-input {
width: 40px;
text-align: center;
font-weight: 600;
border: none;
outline: none;
font-size: 1rem;
}
.btn-modal-add {
flex-grow: 1;
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
font-weight: 600;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
border-radius: 6px;
padding: 0 20px;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.btn-modal-add:hover {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy-hover);
}
/* Cart / Bag Drawer */
.cart-drawer-overlay {
position: fixed;
top: 0;
left: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
background-color: rgba(18,24,36,0.6);
backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
z-index: 3000;
opacity: 0;
pointer-events: none;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.cart-drawer-overlay.open {
opacity: 1;
pointer-events: auto;
}
.cart-drawer {
position: fixed;
top: 0;
right: -450px;
width: 100%;
max-width: 450px;
height: 100%;
background-color: var(--pure-white);
z-index: 3001;
box-shadow: -10px 0 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
transition: right 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
}
.cart-drawer-overlay.open .cart-drawer {
right: 0;
}
.cart-header {
padding: 24px;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: space-between;
}
.cart-header h3 {
font-size: 1.4rem;
}
.cart-close-btn {
font-size: 1.2rem;
cursor: pointer;
color: var(--text-dark);
transition: var(--transition);
}
.cart-close-btn:hover {
color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.cart-items-list {
flex-grow: 1;
overflow-y: auto;
padding: 24px;
}
.cart-item {
display: flex;
gap: 16px;
margin-bottom: 20px;
padding-bottom: 20px;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
position: relative;
}
.cart-item-img {
width: 80px;
height: 100px;
border-radius: 6px;
overflow: hidden;
background-color: #f1f3f5;
flex-shrink: 0;
}
.cart-item-img img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
}
.cart-item-info {
flex-grow: 1;
}
.cart-item-title {
font-size: 0.95rem;
font-weight: 600;
margin-bottom: 4px;
}
.cart-item-meta {
font-size: 0.8rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.cart-item-pricing {
font-size: 0.95rem;
font-weight: 700;
}
.cart-item-controls {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 10px;
margin-top: 10px;
}
.cart-qty-btn {
width: 24px;
height: 24px;
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 4px;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
font-size: 0.8rem;
cursor: pointer;
background-color: var(--bg-ivory);
}
.cart-remove-btn {
position: absolute;
top: 20px;
right: 0;
color: var(--text-muted);
font-size: 0.9rem;
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.cart-remove-btn:hover {
color: #d90429;
}
.cart-footer {
padding: 24px;
border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
background-color: var(--bg-ivory);
}
.cart-summary-row {
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
margin-bottom: 12px;
font-size: 0.95rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
}
.cart-summary-row.total {
font-size: 1.2rem;
font-weight: 700;
color: var(--text-dark);
border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-light);
padding-top: 12px;
margin-top: 12px;
}
.cart-actions {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 12px;
margin-top: 20px;
}
.btn-checkout {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
color: var(--pure-white);
padding: 14px;
text-align: center;
font-weight: 600;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
border-radius: 6px;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.btn-checkout:hover {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy-hover);
}
.btn-continue-shopping {
background-color: transparent;
color: var(--text-dark);
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
padding: 14px;
text-align: center;
font-weight: 600;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
border-radius: 6px;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.btn-continue-shopping:hover {
border-color: var(--text-dark);
}
/* Wishlist View / Orders View / Story View Container */
.dynamic-view-section {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto;
padding: 60px 40px;
display: none;
}
.dynamic-view-section.active {
display: block;
}
.story-content {
max-width: 900px;
margin: 0 auto;
text-align: center;
}
.story-content h2 {
font-size: 2.8rem;
margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.story-content p {
font-size: 1.15rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
line-height: 1.8;
margin-bottom: 30px;
}
.story-grid {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
gap: 40px;
margin-top: 50px;
text-align: left;
align-items: center;
}
.story-img {
border-radius: 12px;
overflow: hidden;
height: 400px;
}
.story-img img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
}
/* Checkout Modal */
.checkout-modal-overlay {
position: fixed;
top: 0;
left: 0;
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
background-color: rgba(18,24,36,0.8);
backdrop-filter: blur(5px);
z-index: 4000;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
opacity: 0;
pointer-events: none;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.checkout-modal-overlay.open {
opacity: 1;
pointer-events: auto;
}
.checkout-modal {
background-color: var(--pure-white);
width: 100%;
max-width: 700px;
border-radius: 16px;
padding: 40px;
max-height: 90vh;
overflow-y: auto;
box-shadow: 0 25px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
position: relative;
}
.checkout-form {
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
gap: 20px;
margin-top: 24px;
}
.form-group {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 8px;
}
.form-group.full-width {
grid-column: 1 / -1;
}
.form-group label {
font-size: 0.85rem;
font-weight: 600;
text-transform: uppercase;
letter-spacing: 0.05em;
}
.form-group input, .form-group select {
padding: 12px 16px;
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 6px;
font-size: 0.95rem;
outline: none;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.form-group input:focus {
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.payment-options {
display: flex;
gap: 16px;
margin-top: 10px;
}
.payment-option {
flex: 1;
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 6px;
padding: 16px;
text-align: center;
cursor: pointer;
transition: var(--transition);
font-weight: 600;
font-size: 0.9rem;
}
.payment-option.selected {
border-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
background-color: rgba(107, 29, 47, 0.05);
color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
/* Order Confirmation View */
.confirmation-box {
text-align: center;
padding: 40px 20px;
}
.confirmation-box i {
font-size: 4rem;
color: #2b9348;
margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.confirmation-box h3 {
font-size: 2rem;
margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.confirmation-box p {
color: var(--text-muted);
margin-bottom: 30px;
}
/* Orders Page View */
.orders-list {
max-width: 800px;
margin: 0 auto;
}
.order-card {
background-color: var(--pure-white);
border: 1px solid var(--border-light);
border-radius: 8px;
padding: 24px;
margin-bottom: 20px;
box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
}
.order-header-row {
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-light);
padding-bottom: 12px;
margin-bottom: 16px;
font-size: 0.9rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
}
.order-item-row {
display: flex;
align-items: center;
gap: 16px;
margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.order-item-img {
width: 60px;
height: 75px;
border-radius: 4px;
overflow: hidden;
background-color: #f1f3f5;
}
.order-item-img img {
width: 100%;
height: 100%;
object-fit: cover;
}
/* Mobile Bottom Nav */
.mobile-bottom-nav {
display: none;
position: fixed;
bottom: 0;
left: 0;
width: 100%;
background-color: var(--pure-white);
border-top: 1px solid var(--border-light);
z-index: 2500;
padding: 10px 0;
justify-content: space-around;
align-items: center;
}
.mobile-nav-item {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
align-items: center;
font-size: 0.75rem;
color: var(--text-muted);
gap: 4px;
cursor: pointer;
position: relative;
}
.mobile-nav-item.active,
.mobile-nav-item:hover {
color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.mobile-nav-item i {
font-size: 1.2rem;
}
/* Footer */
footer {
background-color: var(--text-dark);
color: var(--pure-white);
padding: 80px 40px 40px;
margin-top: 100px;
}
.footer-container {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto;
display: grid;
grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
gap: 60px;
margin-bottom: 60px;
}
.footer-brand h2 {
font-size: 1.8rem;
letter-spacing: 0.15em;
margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.footer-brand span {
font-size: 0.75rem;
letter-spacing: 0.3em;
color: var(--gold);
text-transform: uppercase;
font-weight: 600;
display: block;
margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.footer-brand p {
color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
font-size: 0.95rem;
line-height: 1.7;
max-width: 350px;
}
.footer-col h4 {
font-size: 1rem;
letter-spacing: 0.1em;
text-transform: uppercase;
margin-bottom: 24px;
color: var(--gold);
}
.footer-col ul {
display: flex;
flex-direction: column;
gap: 12px;
}
.footer-col a {
color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
font-size: 0.95rem;
transition: var(--transition);
}
.footer-col a:hover {
color: var(--pure-white);
padding-left: 5px;
}
.footer-socials {
display: flex;
gap: 16px;
margin-top: 24px;
}
.footer-socials a {
width: 40px;
height: 40px;
background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
border-radius: 50%;
display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;
font-size: 1rem;
color: var(--pure-white);
transition: var(--transition);
}
.footer-socials a:hover {
background-color: var(--accent-burgundy);
}
.footer-bottom {
max-width: 1440px;
margin: 0 auto;
border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
padding-top: 30px;
text-align: center;
color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
font-size: 0.85rem;
}
/* Animations */
@keyframes fadeIn {
from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(15px); }
to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}
/* Responsive Media Queries */
@media(max-width: 1024px) {
.product-grid {
grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
}
.footer-container {
grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
gap: 40px;
}
.festive-banner {
flex-direction: column;
text-align: center;
padding: 50px 30px;
gap: 30px;
}
.festive-image {
width: 100%;
max-width: 400px;
margin: 0 auto;
}
}
@media(max-width: 768px) {
.header-container {
padding: 16px 20px;
}
.nav-links {
display: none;
}
.mobile-menu-toggle {
display: block;
}
.product-grid {
grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
gap: 16px;
}
.hero-content h2 {
font-size: 2.5rem;
}
.modal-content {
grid-template-columns: 1fr;
max-height: 90vh;
}
.modal-img-area {
height: 300px;
}
.mobile-bottom-nav {
display: flex;
}
body {
padding-bottom: 60px;
}

grid-template-columns: 1fr;
}
.shop-container, .category-section,
.festive-banner-section {
padding-left: 20px;
padding-right: 20px;
}
}
</style>
</head>

// App State
let currentCategory = "All";
let currentSearchQuery = "";
let currentSortBy = "featured";
let activeView = "shop"; // 'shop', 'wishlist', 'orders',
'story'
// LocalStorage Cart & Wishlist & Orders
let cart = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('saanjh_cart')) ||
[];
let wishlist =
JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('saanjh_wishlist')) || [];
let orders = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('saanjh_orders'))
|| [];
// Active Modal Product State
let selectedProductForModal = null;
let selectedModalColor = "";
let selectedModalSize = "";
let modalQuantity = 1;
let selectedPaymentType = "UPI";
// Initialization on Load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
renderCategories();
renderFilterChips();
filterAndRenderProducts();
updateBadges();
renderCartDrawerItems();
renderWishlistView();
renderOrdersView();
});
// Navigation & View Switching
function switchView(viewName) {
activeView = viewName;
// Toggle main sections
const mainHomeView =
document.getElementById('mainHomeView');
const shopContainer =
document.getElementById('shopCollectionArea');
const wishlistView =
document.getElementById('wishlistView');
const ordersView = document.getElementById('ordersView');
const storyView = document.getElementById('storyView');
// Hide all views first
mainHomeView.style.display = 'none';
shopContainer.style.display = 'none';
wishlistView.classList.remove('active');
ordersView.classList.remove('active');
storyView.classList.remove('active');
// Update nav active state
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link-item').forEach(el =>
el.classList.remove('active'));
document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-nav-item').forEach(el
=> el.classList.remove('active'));
if (viewName === 'shop') {
mainHomeView.style.display = 'block';
shopContainer.style.display = 'block';
document.querySelector('.nav-link-item[data-view="shop"]')?.classList.
add('active');
document.querySelector('.mobile-nav-item[data-mobview="shop"]')?.class
List.add('active');
window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
} else if (viewName === 'wishlist') {
wishlistView.classList.add('active');
renderWishlistView();
window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
} else if (viewName === 'orders') {
ordersView.classList.add('active');
renderOrdersView();
window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
} else if (viewName === 'story') {
storyView.classList.add('active');
document.querySelector('.nav-link-item[data-view="story"]')?.classList
.add('active');
window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
}
}
function scrollToShop() {
switchView('shop');
document.getElementById('shopCollectionArea').scrollIntoView({
behavior: 'smooth' });
}
function scrollToCategories() {
switchView('shop');
document.getElementById('categories').scrollIntoView({
behavior: 'smooth' });
}
function toggleSearchFocus() {
switchView('shop');
const searchInput =
document.getElementById('searchInput');
searchInput.focus();
searchInput.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
}

grid.innerHTML = "";
// Category representative images
const catImages = {

// Render Filter Chips
function renderFilterChips() {
const wrap = document.getElementById('filterChipsWrap');
wrap.innerHTML = "";
// 'All' chip
const allChip = document.createElement('button');
allChip.className = `filter-chip ${currentCategory ===
'All' ? 'active' : ''}`;
allChip.innerText = "All";
allChip.onclick = () => selectCategory("All");
wrap.appendChild(allChip);
categoriesList.forEach(cat => {
const chip = document.createElement('button');
chip.className = `filter-chip ${currentCategory ===
cat ? 'active' : ''}`;
chip.innerText = cat;
chip.onclick = () => selectCategory(cat);
wrap.appendChild(chip);
});
}
function selectCategory(catName) {
currentCategory = catName;
switchView('shop');
renderFilterChips();
filterAndRenderProducts();
// Update headings
const heading =
document.getElementById('collectionHeading');
const subHeading =
document.getElementById('collectionSubHeading');
if (catName === "All") {
heading.innerText = "All Collections";
subHeading.innerText = `Showing complete exquisite
catalog (${productsData.length} styles available)`;
} else {
const count = productsData.filter(p => p.category ===
catName).length;
heading.innerText = catName;
subHeading.innerText = `${count} styles available`;
}
document.getElementById('shopCollectionArea').scrollIntoView({
behavior: 'smooth' });
}
function filterFestiveEdit() {
selectCategory("Festive Edit");
}
function handleSearchInput(e) {
currentSearchQuery = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim();
filterAndRenderProducts();
}
function handleSortChange(e) {
currentSortBy = e.target.value;
filterAndRenderProducts();
}
// Core Filtering, Searching & Sorting Engine
function filterAndRenderProducts() {
let filtered = productsData.filter(p => {
const matchesCategory = (currentCategory === "All" ||
p.category === currentCategory);
const matchesSearch = (
p.name.toLowerCase().includes(currentSearchQuery)
||
p.category.toLowerCase().includes(currentSearchQuery) ||
p.description.toLowerCase().includes(currentSearchQuery)
);
return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
});
// Sorting logic
if (currentSortBy === "price-low") {
filtered.sort((a, b) => a.price - b.price);
} else if (currentSortBy === "price-high") {
filtered.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price);
} else if (currentSortBy === "newest") {
filtered.sort((a, b) => (b.newProduct === true) -
(a.newProduct === true));
} else if (currentSortBy === "discount") {
filtered.sort((a, b) => parseInt(b.discount) -
parseInt(a.discount));
} else {
// Featured
filtered.sort((a, b) => (b.featured === true) -
(a.featured === true));
}
renderProductGrid(filtered);
}
// Render Product Grid
function renderProductGrid(products) {
const grid = document.getElementById('productGrid');
grid.innerHTML = "";
if (products.length === 0) {
grid.innerHTML = `<div class="no-products">No products
found matching your criteria.</div>`;
return;
}
products.forEach(product => {
const isWishlisted = wishlist.some(item => item.id ===
product.id);
const card = document.createElement('div');
card.className = 'product-card';
card.innerHTML = `
<div class="product-img-wrap"
onclick="openProductModal('${product.id}')">
<img src="${product.image}"
alt="${product.name}">
<span
class="product-badge">${product.badge}</span>
<button class="wishlist-btn ${isWishlisted ?
'active' : ''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();
toggleWishlist('${product.id}')">
<i class="${isWishlisted ? 'fa-solid
fa-heart' : 'fa-regular fa-heart'}"></i>
</button>
</div>
<div class="product-info">
<div
class="product-cat-name">${product.category}</div>
<h3 class="product-title"
onclick="openProductModal('${product.id}')">${product.name}</h3>
<div class="product-pricing">
<span
class="current-price">₹${product.price.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
<span
class="original-price">₹${product.originalPrice.toLocaleString('en-IN'
)}</span>
<span
class="discount-tag">${product.discount}</span>
</div>
<button class="btn-add-bag"
onclick="quickAddProductToBag('${product.id}')">Add To Bag</button>
</div>
`;
grid.appendChild(card);
});
}
// Product Detail Modal
function openProductModal(productId) {
selectedProductForModal = productsData.find(p => p.id ===
productId);
if (!selectedProductForModal) return;
document.getElementById('modalProductImg').src =
selectedProductForModal.image;
document.getElementById('modalProductCat').innerText =
selectedProductForModal.category;
document.getElementById('modalProductTitle').innerText =
selectedProductForModal.name;
document.getElementById('modalCurrentPrice').innerText =
`₹${selectedProductForModal.price.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
document.getElementById('modalOriginalPrice').innerText =
`₹${selectedProductForModal.originalPrice.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
document.getElementById('modalDiscountTag').innerText =
selectedProductForModal.discount;
document.getElementById('modalProductDesc').innerText =
selectedProductForModal.description;
modalQuantity = 1;
document.getElementById('modalQtyInput').value =
modalQuantity;
// Render Colors
const colorContainer =
document.getElementById('modalColorChips');
colorContainer.innerHTML = "";
if (selectedProductForModal.colors &&
selectedProductForModal.colors.length > 0) {
document.getElementById('colorOptionsGroup').style.display = 'block';
selectedModalColor =
selectedProductForModal.colors[0];
selectedProductForModal.colors.forEach((col, idx) => {
const chip = document.createElement('div');
chip.className = `color-chip ${idx === 0 ?
'selected' : ''}`;
chip.style.backgroundColor = col;
chip.onclick = () => {
document.querySelectorAll('.color-chip').forEach(c =>
c.classList.remove('selected'));
chip.classList.add('selected');
selectedModalColor = col;
};
colorContainer.appendChild(chip);
});
} else {
document.getElementById('colorOptionsGroup').style.display = 'none';
}
// Render Sizes
const sizeContainer =
document.getElementById('modalSizeChips');
sizeContainer.innerHTML = "";
if (selectedProductForModal.sizes &&
selectedProductForModal.sizes.length > 0) {
document.getElementById('sizeOptionsGroup').style.display = 'block';
selectedModalSize = selectedProductForModal.sizes[0];
selectedProductForModal.sizes.forEach((sz, idx) => {
const chip = document.createElement('div');
chip.className = `size-chip ${idx === 0 ?
'selected' : ''}`;
chip.innerText = sz;
chip.onclick = () => {
document.querySelectorAll('.size-chip').forEach(s =>
s.classList.remove('selected'));
chip.classList.add('selected');
selectedModalSize = sz;
};
sizeContainer.appendChild(chip);
});
} else {
document.getElementById('sizeOptionsGroup').style.display = 'none';
}
document.getElementById('productDetailModal').classList.add('open');
}
function closeProductModal(e) {
document.getElementById('productDetailModal').classList.remove('open')
;
}
function closeProductModalDirect() {
document.getElementById('productDetailModal').classList.remove('open')
;
}
function adjustModalQty(change) {
modalQuantity += change;
if (modalQuantity < 1) modalQuantity = 1;
document.getElementById('modalQtyInput').value =
modalQuantity;
}
function addProductFromModalToBag() {
if (!selectedProductForModal) return;
addToCart(selectedProductForModal, modalQuantity,
selectedModalColor, selectedModalSize);
closeProductModalDirect();
toggleCartDrawer(true);
}
function quickAddProductToBag(productId) {
const product = productsData.find(p => p.id ===
productId);
if (!product) return;
const defaultColor = product.colors ? product.colors[0] :
'Standard';
const defaultSize = product.sizes ? product.sizes[0] :
'Free Size';
addToCart(product, 1, defaultColor, defaultSize);
toggleCartDrawer(true);
}
// Cart Management
function addToCart(product, quantity, color, size) {
const cartItemId = `${product.id}-${color}-${size}`;
const existingIndex = cart.findIndex(item =>
item.cartItemId === cartItemId);
if (existingIndex > -1) {
cart[existingIndex].quantity += quantity;
} else {
cart.push({
cartItemId,
id: product.id,
name: product.name,
price: product.price,
image: product.image,
color: color,
size: size,
quantity: quantity,
category: product.category
});
}
saveCartAndRefresh();
}
function updateCartItemQuantity(cartItemId, change) {
const item = cart.find(i => i.cartItemId === cartItemId);
if (!item) return;
item.quantity += change;
if (item.quantity <= 0) {
removeFromCart(cartItemId);
} else {
saveCartAndRefresh();
}
}
function removeFromCart(cartItemId) {
cart = cart.filter(i => i.cartItemId !== cartItemId);
saveCartAndRefresh();
}
function saveCartAndRefresh() {
localStorage.setItem('saanjh_cart', JSON.stringify(cart));
updateBadges();
renderCartDrawerItems();
}
function updateBadges() {
const totalCartItems = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum +
item.quantity, 0);
document.getElementById('cartCountBadge').innerText =
totalCartItems;
document.getElementById('wishlistCountBadge').innerText =
wishlist.length;
}
function toggleCartDrawer(open) {
const drawerOverlay =
document.getElementById('cartDrawerOverlay');
if (open) {
drawerOverlay.classList.add('open');
renderCartDrawerItems();
} else {
drawerOverlay.classList.remove('open');
}
}
function renderCartDrawerItems() {
const listContainer =
document.getElementById('cartItemsList');
listContainer.innerHTML = "";
if (cart.length === 0) {
listContainer.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:
center; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 40px 0;">Your shopping bag
is empty.</div>`;
document.getElementById('cartSubtotal').innerText =
"₹0";
document.getElementById('cartTotal').innerText = "₹0";
return;
}
let subtotal = 0;
cart.forEach(item => {
subtotal += (item.price * item.quantity);
const el = document.createElement('div');
el.className = 'cart-item';
el.innerHTML = `
<div class="cart-item-img">
<img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.name}">
</div>
<div class="cart-item-info">
<h4 class="cart-item-title">${item.name}</h4>
<div class="cart-item-meta">Size:
${item.size}</div>
<div class="cart-item-pricing">₹${(item.price
* item.quantity).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
<div class="cart-item-controls">
<button class="cart-qty-btn"
onclick="updateCartItemQuantity('${item.cartItemId}', -1)"><i
class="fa-solid fa-minus"></i></button>
<span style="font-size: 0.9rem;
font-weight: 600; width: 20px; text-align:
center;">${item.quantity}</span>
<button class="cart-qty-btn"
onclick="updateCartItemQuantity('${item.cartItemId}', 1)"><i
class="fa-solid fa-plus"></i></button>
</div>
</div>
<button class="cart-remove-btn"
onclick="removeFromCart('${item.cartItemId}')"><i class="fa-solid
fa-trash-can"></i></button>
`;
listContainer.appendChild(el);
});
document.getElementById('cartSubtotal').innerText =
`₹${subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
document.getElementById('cartTotal').innerText =
`₹${subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
}
// Wishlist Management
function toggleWishlist(productId) {
const product = productsData.find(p => p.id ===
productId);
if (!product) return;
const idx = wishlist.findIndex(item => item.id ===
productId);
if (idx > -1) {
wishlist.splice(idx, 1);
} else {
wishlist.push(product);
}
localStorage.setItem('saanjh_wishlist',
JSON.stringify(wishlist));
updateBadges();
filterAndRenderProducts();
if (activeView === 'wishlist') {
renderWishlistView();
}
}
function renderWishlistView() {
const grid =
document.getElementById('wishlistProductGrid');
grid.innerHTML = "";
if (wishlist.length === 0) {
grid.innerHTML = `<div class="no-products">Your
wishlist is empty. Explore our exquisite collections and add your
favorite pieces.</div>`;
return;
}
wishlist.forEach(product => {
const card = document.createElement('div');
card.className = 'product-card';
card.innerHTML = `
<div class="product-img-wrap"
onclick="openProductModal('${product.id}')">
<img src="${product.image}"
alt="${product.name}">
<span
class="product-badge">${product.badge}</span>
<button class="wishlist-btn active"
onclick="event.stopPropagation(); toggleWishlist('${product.id}')">
<i class="fa-solid fa-heart"></i>
</button>
</div>
<div class="product-info">
<div
class="product-cat-name">${product.category}</div>
<h3 class="product-title"
onclick="openProductModal('${product.id}')">${product.name}</h3>
<div class="product-pricing">
<span
class="current-price">₹${product.price.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span>
<span
class="original-price">₹${product.originalPrice.toLocaleString('en-IN'
)}</span>
<span
class="discount-tag">${product.discount}</span>
</div>
<button class="btn-add-bag"
onclick="quickAddProductToBag('${product.id}')">Add To Bag</button>
</div>
`;
grid.appendChild(card);
});
}
// Checkout & Orders Flow
function openCheckoutModal() {
if (cart.length === 0) {
alert("Your shopping bag is empty.");
return;
}
toggleCartDrawer(false);
const subtotal = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum +
(item.price * item.quantity), 0);
document.getElementById('checkoutBtnTotal').innerText =
`₹${subtotal.toLocaleString('en-IN')}`;
document.getElementById('checkoutFormContainer').style.display =
'block';
document.getElementById('orderConfirmationContainer').style.display =
'none';
document.getElementById('checkoutModalOverlay').classList.add('open');
}
function closeCheckoutModal() {
document.getElementById('checkoutModalOverlay').classList.remove('open
');
}
function selectPaymentMethod(type, el) {
selectedPaymentType = type;
document.querySelectorAll('.payment-option').forEach(opt
=> opt.classList.remove('selected'));
el.classList.add('selected');
}
function handlePlaceOrder(e) {
e.preventDefault();
const name = document.getElementById('checkName').value;
const mobile =
document.getElementById('checkMobile').value;
const email = document.getElementById('checkEmail').value;
const address =
document.getElementById('checkAddress').value;
const city = document.getElementById('checkCity').value;
const state = document.getElementById('checkState').value;
const pincode =
document.getElementById('checkPincode').value;
const subtotal = cart.reduce((sum, item) => sum +
(item.price * item.quantity), 0);
const newOrder = {
orderId: 'SZH-' + Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() *
900000),
date: new Date().toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day:
'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }),
items: [...cart],
total: subtotal,
shippingAddress: { name, mobile, email, address, city,
state, pincode },
paymentMethod: selectedPaymentType,
status: 'Confirmed & Preparing'
};
orders.unshift(newOrder);
localStorage.setItem('saanjh_orders',
JSON.stringify(orders));
// Clear cart
cart = [];
saveCartAndRefresh();
// Show confirmation screen inside modal
document.getElementById('checkoutFormContainer').style.display =
'none';
document.getElementById('orderConfirmationContainer').style.display =
'block';
}
function closeCheckoutAndGoOrders() {
closeCheckoutModal();
switchView('orders');
}
function renderOrdersView() {
const container =
document.getElementById('ordersListContainer');
container.innerHTML = "";
if (orders.length === 0) {
container.innerHTML = `
<div style="text-align: center; padding: 60px
20px; color: var(--text-muted);">
<h3 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display',
serif; font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 12px;">No orders yet</h3>
<p>Your orders will appear here after
checkout.</p>
</div>
`;
return;
}
orders.forEach(order => {
const card = document.createElement('div');
card.className = 'order-card';
let itemsHtml = "";
order.items.forEach(item => {
itemsHtml += `
<div class="order-item-row">
<div class="order-item-img">
<img src="${item.image}"
alt="${item.name}">
</div>
<div style="flex-grow: 1;">
<div style="font-weight: 600;
font-size: 0.95rem;">${item.name}</div>
<div style="font-size: 0.8rem; color:
var(--text-muted);">Size: ${item.size} | Qty: ${item.quantity}</div>
</div>
<div style="font-weight: 700; font-size:
0.95rem;">₹${(item.price *
item.quantity).toLocaleString('en-IN')}</div>
</div>
`;
});
card.innerHTML = `
<div class="order-header-row">
<div><strong>Order ID:</strong>
${order.orderId}</div>
<div><strong>Date:</strong>
${order.date}</div>
<div><strong>Status:</strong> <span
style="color: #2b9348; font-weight: 600;">${order.status}</span></div>
</div>
${itemsHtml}
<div style="display: flex; justify-content:
space-between; align-items: center; border-top: 1px solid
var(--border-light); padding-top: 12px; margin-top: 12px; font-size:
0.95rem;">
<div><strong>Payment:</strong>
${order.paymentMethod}</div>
<div><strong>Total Amount:</strong> <span
style="font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight:
700;">₹${order.total.toLocaleString('en-IN')}</span></div>
</div>
`;
container.appendChild(card);
});
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
